headstone_A1.style_usage: Stardew Valley's own tombstone: match its palette, outline, shading and size exactly
headstone_A1.description: A small old carved stone headstone in a village graveyard, Stardew Valley style, front view slightly from above. Pale grey granite, rounded arched top, a smooth recessed face panel cut deep and clean (left blank, no text), a thin carved border, a short plinth at the base with a few grass tufts. Soft grey shading, darker grey outline.

headstone_A2.style_usage: Stardew Valley's own tombstone: match its palette, outline, shading and size exactly
headstone_A2.description: A small old carved stone headstone in a village graveyard, Stardew Valley style, front view slightly from above. Warm grey sandstone, top with carved shoulders and a pointed gable, a flat face cut deep and clean (left blank, no text), a short base step, a little moss at the foot. Soft shading, darker grey outline.

headstone_A3.style_usage: Stardew Valley's own tombstone: match its palette, outline, shading and size exactly
headstone_A3.description: A small old carved stone headstone in a village graveyard, Stardew Valley style, front view slightly from above. Blue-grey slate, a gently rounded top with two small carved scrolls at the shoulders, a smooth face cut deep and clean (left blank, no text), set on a low stone footing with grass tufts. Soft shading, darker blue-grey outline.

echo_agnes_ink.style_usage: a Stardew Valley villager sprite: match its size, proportions and pixel scale (the figure about this tall)
echo_agnes_ink.look: ink: sepia ink linework with a pale cream wash; oil: loose gold, ochre and umber brushstrokes
echo_agnes_ink.description: A loose unfinished pixel-art sketch of a woman painter at work, side view facing right, standing at a wooden easel with a small canvas, her brush raised mid-stroke, palette in her other hand, hair tied up, a long smock. Drawn as quick sepia-brown ink linework with a pale cream wash, lines trailing off unfinished at her skirt hem and the easel legs. Solid opaque strokes, not a ghost. Stardew Valley NPC scale.
